title: Reign of Queen Nitocris (Netjerkare Siptah)
summary: CFAH AP-16: Nitocris reigned approximately 1497–1479 BC; CFAH-6 has her follow Merenre II, who died in 1491 BC.
description: CFAH AP-16: Nitocris reigned approximately 1497–1479 BC; CFAH-6 has her follow Merenre II, who died in 1491 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-16: Nitocris Reigned from 1497 to 1479 B.C."; CFAH-6 Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #16
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "Approximate reign of Nitocris aka Netjerkare Siptah"
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.

chronologies.date: “The queen bore the same name as the Babylonian princess, namely, Nitocris.”
chronologies.citation: Herodotus, Histories 2.100 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 136 (PDF p. 138)
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 cites this chapter for Nitocris following Merenre II (AP-16, 1497–1479 BC). Order differs: Herodotus puts Nitocris among the 330 kings before Moeris (2.101); CFAH dates Moeris's death (about 1679 BC) before Nitocris (1497 BC), treating the lines as parallel.
